_about: laneHITFX v81 AAA hit feel (Scripts/Combat/HitFeel.cs + HitFeelTable; BloodBurst and CombatVFX read blood{}). Every number lives here. Missing file = HitFeel off and the v69 look (code defaults). visual-qc must gate any change (spark intensity, flash lumen, blood colours).

hitstop._about: ms = lerp(minMs, maxMs, clamp01((damage - dmgLo) / (dmgHi - dmgLo))), damage = health the victim lost on this contact (1 when dmgHi <= dmgLo, so minMs..maxMs collapse to maxMs; use minMs = maxMs for a fixed stop). Dracula/Pitborn move damage: light 14, thrust 11, riposte 24, heavy_overhead 18, heavy_counter 20, heavy_riposte 30, critical 40 (x damage mults). PresentationClock keeps the longest request, so hit_stop.json (the old floor) never adds on top. Not requested while a finisher owns the clock; x duringSlowMoMul while CombatSlowMo runs. slow_mo.json delayS (parry 0.10, deathblow 0.12, crit 0.08) makes the dip start after the freeze.

sparks._about: HDR emissive streaks on Furnace/Particle (additive, display-referred): intensity 8 at 2200 K cooling to 1700 K at coolAt. Size x clamp(cameraDistance / refDistance, 1, maxGrow) so it reads at gameplay distance. countBase + countPerStrength * rows[].spark, x countScaleHeavy on a heavy blow, +-countRandom.

flash._about: Warm point light (HDRP lumens, no shadows) for `seconds` of unscaled time, intensity falls as (1 - age/seconds)^falloffPower, peak = lumen * rows[].flash, placed towardCamera metres in front of the contact. Same lumen order as MoveSheet's lights (12000 lm / 4 m) under the fixed EV 9.4.

blood._about: B1 fixes. lengthScale 1.6 (droplets, not needles; was 3.2 before v69), wet dark colour (0.35,0.02,0.02) fading to endColor, softDistance 0.15 on the bloodStrands material (-1 = leave the fx_materials.json value), velocityScale = small flight stretch, sizeScale / countScale x the BloodBurst V3 numbers. dropColor / mistColor = CombatVFX BloodDrops / BloodMist start colours (were 0.145,0.008,0.008 and 0.22,0.015,0.015).
blood._aboutSpray: HCAUDIT1 v104: the FINISHER blood spray (GoreFx.Spray) - separate from startColor/endColor above (those feed the hit burst). Values = the v69 literals GoreFx.cs had.
